channel.title: Treasure Coast Today
channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Sunday for $3 million renovation to expand slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a year-long $3 million renovation that will expand capacity from 18 to 44 slips and add storm-resistant features.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs rise 4 percent as inflation hits holiday meal prices
item.description: A Fourth of July meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4 percent from a year ago, according to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey.

item.title: Riviera Beach named only Florida city to receive 2026 All-America City Award
item.description: The City of Riviera Beach was selected as one of just 10 communities nationwide to receive the 2026 All-America City Award from the National Civic League, making it the only Florida city honored this year.

item.title: Juno Beach residents seek fence replacement at JB-7 beach access as trespassing disputes mount
item.description: Residents at the Colony Condos in Juno Beach say people using the JB-7 public walkway are cutting through their private property since the town removed the old fence in 2023 for safety reasons.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams on standby as Fourth of July boaters take to waterways
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit will have two boats with medics on standby in the north and south parts of the county as hundreds of boaters are expected on the water this Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce property into artistic destination with global reach
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, putting the Peacock Arts District on the map while preserving the historic Crain Estate.

item.title: Martin County School Board fights judge's order to reinstate teacher suspended over Charlie Kirk comments
item.description: The Martin County School Board is challenging a judge's recommendation to reinstate a teacher who was suspended last year after making social media comments abo.

item.title: Delray Beach's S.D. Spady Elementary jumps from C to A rating as Palm Beach County schools earn third consecutive A
item.description: The School District of Palm Beach County earned an A rating from the state for the third consecutive year, with S.D. Spady Elementary School in Delray Beach making a dramatic leap from a C rating to an A.

item.title: Fourth of July cookout costs up 4% as ground beef and bun prices climb
item.description: According to the American Farm Bureau Federation's Summer Cookout Cost Survey, a holiday meal for 10 now costs $73.82, up 4% from a year ago.

item.title: Port St. Lucie approves land transfer for new Florida Turnpike interchange at Midway Road
item.description: The Port St. Lucie City Council approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to FDOT to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike in St. Lucie County.

item.title: Glydways proposes elevated autonomous transit from West Palm Beach to airport
item.description: A California-based autonomous transit company is proposing an elevated network of self-driving vehicles that would connect downtown West Palm Beach to President Donald J. Trump International Airport.

item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation draws global artists to Fort Pierce historic estate
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, putting the Peacock Arts District on the map and connecting local and international artists.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock to close July 6 for $3 million renovation nearly doubling slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue two boaters after vessel sinks in Intracoastal
item.description: Two boaters are safe after their vessel sank in the Intracoastal Waterway on Wednesday, thanks to a quick response from marine deputies and the life-saving decision to wear life jackets.

item.title: Martin County maritime teams deploy two boats with medics for Fourth of July weekend
item.description: Martin County Maritime Response Unit is stationing two boats with medics in north and south Martin County as hundreds of boaters hit the water for the Fourth of July weekend.

item.title: Hobe Sound woman remembered after deadly home fire Monday
item.description: Misty Dawn White, 46, died Monday in a Hobe Sound home fire that preliminary findings from the sheriff's office point to an electrical issue as a possible cause.
